carousel.description: A full-width rotating banner. Each row is one slide: an image in the first column, then a heading, a short line and a link; make the link bold to show it as a button. With two or more rows it turns every 6 seconds; one row stays still.
carousel.html:
Carousel, three slides

commerce-account-header.description: The heading at the top of an account page. One row: Title, with the heading text (default My account).

commerce-account-nav.description: The account menu. The first row names the columns (label, icon, permission). Each row after is one link: a link plus a description line, an icon name (such as Order, AddressBook or Business), and the permission that shows it (all for everyone).
commerce-account-nav.html:
Commerce Account Nav

icon
permission

commerce-account-nav.structureOnly: it shows the menu entries the signed-in customer's permissions allow, so it needs a live store.

commerce-account-sidebar.description: The account sidebar. The block itself holds nothing; its entries come from the /customer/sidebar-fragment document.
commerce-account-sidebar.structureOnly: it loads the /customer/sidebar-fragment document and shows the signed-in customer's account links.

commerce-addresses.description: The customer's saved addresses. One row: Minified View, true for the short summary shown on the account page, false (default) for the full list.
commerce-addresses.structureOnly: it shows the signed-in customer's saved addresses from a live store.

commerce-b2b-company-hierarchy.description: The company structure tree. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-company-hierarchy.structureOnly: it shows the signed-in company user's company structure from a live store.

commerce-b2b-negotiable-quote.description: The negotiable quote list and details page. Nothing to fill in; the quote comes from the page address.
commerce-b2b-negotiable-quote.structureOnly: it shows the company's negotiable quotes from a live store.

commerce-b2b-negotiable-quote-template.description: The quote template list and details page. Nothing to fill in; the template comes from the page address.
commerce-b2b-negotiable-quote-template.structureOnly: it shows the company's quote templates from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-approval-flow.description: The approval steps of a purchase order. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-approval-flow.structureOnly: it shows one purchase order's approval flow from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-approval-rule-details.description: The details of one purchase order approval rule. Nothing to fill in; the rule comes from the page address.
commerce-b2b-po-approval-rule-details.structureOnly: it shows one approval rule from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-approval-rule-form.description: The form to create or edit a purchase order approval rule. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-approval-rule-form.structureOnly: it saves approval rules to a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-approval-rules-list.description: The list of purchase order approval rules. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-approval-rules-list.structureOnly: it lists the company's approval rules from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-checkout-success.description: The confirmation shown after a purchase order is placed. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-checkout-success.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a Continue Shopping button: the rest is the purchase order just placed, read from the live store.

commerce-b2b-po-comment-form.description: The form to add a comment to a purchase order. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-comment-form.structureOnly: it saves comments to a purchase order in a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-comments-list.description: The comments on a purchase order. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-comments-list.structureOnly: it shows one purchase order's comments from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-company-purchase-orders.description: The list of the company's purchase orders. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-company-purchase-orders.structureOnly: it lists the company's purchase orders from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-customer-purchase-orders.description: The list of the customer's own purchase orders. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-customer-purchase-orders.structureOnly: it lists the signed-in customer's purchase orders from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-header.description: The heading of a purchase order page, with a link back to all purchase orders. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-header.structureOnly: on its own it shows only its title: the rest is the order, return or account of a signed-in shopper, read from the live store.

commerce-b2b-po-history-log.description: The history of changes to a purchase order. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-history-log.structureOnly: it shows one purchase order's history from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-require-approval-purchas.description: The purchase orders waiting for the customer's approval. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-require-approval-purchas.html: Commerce B2b Po Require Approval Purchase Orders
commerce-b2b-po-require-approval-purchas.structureOnly: it lists purchase orders needing approval from a live store.

commerce-b2b-po-status.description: The status of a purchase order. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-po-status.structureOnly: it shows one purchase order's status from a live store.

commerce-b2b-quick-order.description: The quick order page: add items by product code, pasted list or file. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-quick-order.structureOnly: it looks up products and fills the cart in a live store.

commerce-b2b-quote-checkout.description: Checkout for a negotiable quote. Nothing to fill in; the quote comes from the page address.
commerce-b2b-quote-checkout.structureOnly: it checks out a negotiable quote in a live store.

commerce-b2b-requisition-list.description: The customer's requisition lists. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-requisition-list.structureOnly: it lists the customer's requisition lists from a live store and sends signed-out visitors to sign in.

commerce-b2b-requisition-list-public-sha.description: A shared requisition list opened from a share link. Nothing to fill in; the share link supplies the list, and a visit without it goes to the home page.
commerce-b2b-requisition-list-public-sha.structureOnly: it loads a shared requisition list from a live store and redirects without a share link.

commerce-b2b-requisition-list-sharing.description: The page that shares a requisition list. Nothing to fill in.
commerce-b2b-requisition-list-sharing.structureOnly: it shares a requisition list in a live store.

commerce-b2b-requisition-list-view.description: One requisition list and its items. Nothing to fill in; the list comes from the page address.
commerce-b2b-requisition-list-view.structureOnly: it shows one requisition list from a live store and sends signed-out visitors to sign in.

commerce-cart.description: The shopping cart: the shopper's items, the order summary and the way to checkout. Each row is a setting and its value; the values shown are the block's defaults, with its two links pointing at the home and checkout pages.

commerce-checkout.description: The checkout: contact, addresses, shipping, payment and place order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-checkout-success.description: The order confirmation shown after a purchase. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-checkout-success.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-company-accept-invitation.description: Lets an invited person accept a company invitation. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-company-accept-invitation.structureOnly: on its own it shows "Invalid invitation link": it reads the invitation from the link a company admin emails.

commerce-company-create.description: The form for registering a new company account. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-company-credit.description: The company credit balance and, optionally, its history. One row: Show History, true or false.

commerce-company-profile.description: The company profile page. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-company-roles-permissions.description: Manage company roles and their permissions. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-company-structure.description: The company's teams and users as a tree. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-company-users.description: The list of company users. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-confirm-account.description: Confirms a new customer account from the emailed link. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-create-account.description: The customer registration form. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-create-password.description: Sets a new password from the emailed reset link. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-create-return.description: The form for requesting a return on an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-create-return.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a title and a disabled Continue button: the items come from a signed-in shopper's order.

commerce-customer-company.description: The signed-in customer's company details. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-customer-details.description: The customer's details on an order page. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-customer-details.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-customer-information.description: The customer's account information page. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-forgot-password.description: The form for requesting a password reset. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-gift-options.description: Gift options for the cart or an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-login.description: The customer sign-in form. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-mini-cart.description: The slide-out cart. Each row is a setting; leave a URL empty to use the default.
commerce-mini-cart.html:

commerce-order-comments.description: Order comments on an order page. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-order-comments.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-order-cost-summary.description: The cost breakdown of an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-order-cost-summary.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-order-header.description: The header of an order page with its number and date. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-order-header.structureOnly: on its own it shows only its title: the rest is the order, return or account of a signed-in shopper, read from the live store.

commerce-order-product-list.description: The products on an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-order-product-list.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-order-returns.description: The returns made on an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-order-status.description: The status of an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-order-status.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-orders-list.description: The customer's order history. Each row is a setting: Minified View and Search, true or false.

commerce-return-header.description: The header of a return page. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-return-header.structureOnly: on its own it shows only its title: the rest is the order, return or account of a signed-in shopper, read from the live store.

commerce-returns-list.description: The customer's returns. One row: Minified View, true or false.

commerce-search-order.description: A form to look up an order by number and email. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-seller-assisted-buying-activity.description: Activity log for seller-assisted buying. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-seller-assisted-buying-settings.description: Settings for seller-assisted buying. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.

commerce-shipping-status.description: The shipping status of an order. It reads no settings: add the block and leave the cell empty.
commerce-shipping-status.structureOnly: on its own it shows only a loading placeholder: its content is a signed-in shopper's order, account or shipment, read from the live store.

commerce-wishlist.description: The customer's wishlist. One row: Start Shopping URL, the page the empty wishlist links to (empty hides the link).

enrichment.description: Pulls in extra content written for a product or category page: set Type to product or category, and optionally Position to pick one slot; the block then shows every matching fragment from the storefront's enrichment index in its place.
enrichment.html:
Enrichment, on a product page

Type
product
Position
below-details

Enrichment, on a category page

Type
category
Position
above-products
enrichment.structureOnly: it removes itself and shows only the fragments the storefront's enrichment index lists for the product in the page address or the category of the page's product list, so it has nothing to show outside a real storefront.

footer.description: The site footer. It takes no content of its own: it shows the footer document (/footer, or the page named by the page's footer metadata), so edit that document to change the links and text.
footer.structureOnly: it ignores its own table and loads the storefront's footer document, which exists only on a real site.

header.description: The site header: logo, navigation, search, account and cart. It takes no content of its own: it shows the nav document (/nav, or the page named by the page's nav metadata), so edit that document to change the menu.
header.structureOnly: it ignores its own table and loads the storefront's nav document, and its search, account and cart buttons need a live store.

modal.description: A pop-up window that other blocks open (for example the store switcher and quick view); it is not inserted on a page by hand, and the cell holds the content the window would show.
modal.html:
Modal

Sign up for updates

Be the first to hear about new arrivals and offers.
modal.structureOnly: its code is a helper that other blocks call with the content to show; loaded as a block on a page, it has no content list to open and shows nothing.

product-details.description: The product page: gallery, name, price, options, quantity and add to cart, for the product in the page address. Its one setting, Grid Ordering Enabled, set to true shows configurable products as an order grid of every variant.
product-details.html:
Product Details

Grid Ordering Enabled
false

Product Details, with grid ordering

Grid Ordering Enabled
true
product-details.structureOnly: it needs a live store, because it shows the product the storefront loaded for the SKU in the page address.

product-list-page.description: A product grid with filters, sorting and pages. On a category page set urlpath to the category's URL path; leave it out for the search results page. pagesize is the number of products per page (default 9). Write both keys as one word.
product-list-page.html:
Product List Page, for a category

women/tops
pagesize
12

pagesize
9

product-recommendations.description: A row of recommended products. recid names the recommendation unit to show; currentsku pins the product it recommends for (left empty, it uses the product on the page) and currentprice gives that product's price when the store needs it. Write the keys as one word.
product-recommendations.html:

recid
your-recommendation-unit-id

your-recommendation-unit-id
currentsku

product-recommendations.structureOnly: it needs a live store, because the recommendations come from the store's recommendation service for a unit set up there.

targeted-block.description: Content shown only to the shoppers it names. Each row is a setting and its value (Customer Groups, Customer Segments or Cart Rules, as Commerce ids separated by commas), and the last row holds the content; a Fragment row shows that fragment instead.

targeted-block.structureOnly: it loads the storefront header and footer through scripts.js, which needs the storefront's Commerce settings, and it shows its content only to the shoppers a live store names.

widget.description: Loads a custom widget from the storefront code: the cell holds a link to the widget's file under /widgets/ (for example /widgets/store-hours.html), and anything after a ? in the link is passed to the widget as its settings.
widget.structureOnly: it loads the widget's HTML, CSS and script from the storefront code's /widgets/ folder, and the template ships no widgets, so there is nothing to load until a storefront adds one.
